name: Sum 7 Dice Game — The Magic Pair
competency: Understanding 3D polyhedra face opposition, spatial inversion, and the algebraic invariant Top + Bottom = 7 on standard dice
ncertStandard: Grade 1 & 2 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 8 (3D Shapes, Dice and Addition)
overview: A physics-based 3D dice rolling game where children discover the universal geometric rule: opposite faces of a standard six-sided die always sum to 7. Children predict hidden bottom faces and uncover all 3 magical pairs: (1,6), (2,5), (3,4).
learningOutcomes: Identify the mathematical invariant of a standard die (opposite faces sum to 7)
Develop 3D spatial rotation and perspective mental visualization
Categorize and complete all 3 fundamental dice pairs
